stations.title: Ines
stations.say: Can the laptop keep the shelf?
stations.note: She keeps it in her head.

stations.title: Ines's memory
stations.text: Cedar, then Sage, then... she goes to look.

captions: At Wickhollow Candles, Ines wants the laptop to keep the shelf for her.
Today the shelf lives in her head, so every question means a walk to look.
You make the shelf a list and write five small tasks around it.
Now the laptop knows where the Sage is, and what is at the end.
Theo has the shop's rules as functions. Now the shop has its first list.
